Baseball Regional: Bishop Manogue, Spanish Springs stay in winners bracket
Jim Krajewski
Reno Gazette Journal
May 6, 2026, 9:13 p.m. PT
Bishop Manogue shrugged of a first-inning, two-run home run by Nate Cordell to beat Galena, 4-2, on Wednesday in the 5A-North Regional baseball tournament.
Manogue senior Keenan Dolan allowed just one more hit the rest of the way in a complete-game effort. He struck out 12 and went 1-for-3 with a double at the plate.
Also on Wednesday, Spanish Springs beat Reno, 4-1; McQueen beat Reed, 12-8, and Damonte Ranch beat Douglas, 10-0.
On Thursday, at 4 p.m., Spanish Springs plays at Bishop Manogue; Damonte Ranch is at Reno and McQueen plays at Galena.
- In the Miners' win, Aidan Cruz went 1-for-3 with a three-run home run, Nate Lemieux was 2-for-3 with two doubles, and Demari Stacker was 2-for-3 with a triple and a RBI.
- For the Grizzlies, Nathan Cordell 1-3 with a two-run hme run.
- In the Lancers' win, they scored six runs in the bottom of the sixth. Zach Rowe pitched four innings in relief and got the win. Huddy Culbertson went 3-for-4 with two RBIs. The Lancers also got two RBIs each from Brooks Porter, Ky Dimond and Logan Lofstedt.
- Chase Spencer went 3-for-4 with three RBIs for the Raiders and Will Oexle was 2-for4 with three RBIs.
- Reed led, 6-1, after the top of the fourth inning, but the Lancers scored five runs in the bottom of the fourth.
- In the Cougars' win, Wyatt Wirshing was 2-for-3 with a home run and Logan Johnson was 1-for-3 with two RBIs.
- Cole Shaffer got the win, pitching six innings, striking out five and allowing three hits.
- In Damonte's win, senior Kolten Matter got the five-inning win. He did not allow a hit and struck out four with three walks.
- Matt Schreiner, Spencer Dietz and Russell Stanley each had two RBIs. Ike Bross was 2-for-3.
